info.name: Files Connect API
info.description:
# IUDX Files Connect API - Official Documentation & Test Suite

## Overview

The **Files Connect API** enables secure file upload, download, envelope encryption, and asynchronous batch processing. This collection provides complete endpoint coverage, automated JWT token management for Keycloak, contract test suites, and verified response examples.

- **Base URL**: `https://v2.dev.iudx.io/files-connect-api`
    
- **Specification (ReDoc)**: [https://v2.dev.iudx.io/files-connect-api/apis](https://v2.dev.iudx.io/files-connect-api/apis)
    
- **OpenAPI 3.0 Spec**: [https://v2.dev.iudx.io/files-connect-api/openapi.json](https://v2.dev.iudx.io/files-connect-api/openapi.json)
    

---

## Authentication & Authorization Model

All protected endpoints require an OpenID Connect JWT Bearer token issued by the IUDX Keycloak identity provider.

- **Keycloak Token URL**: `https://v2.dev.iudx.io/auth/realms/iudx-v2/protocol/openid-connect/token`
    
- **Realm**: `iudx-v2`
    
- **Client ID**: `angular-client`
    
- **Grant Type**: `password`
    

### Pre-configured User Roles & Personas

| Persona | Email | Assigned Roles | Access Scope |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **CosAdmin** | `admin.cos.iudx.v2@datakaveri.org` | `cos_admin`, `consumer`, `superset_Admin` | System administration & governance |
| **Provider** | `paramesh@sirpi.io` | `consumer`, `default-roles-tgdex-pilot` | Asset upload, Envelope Encryption public-key retrieval, Databank management |
| **Consumer** | `lawovo4579@synsky.com` | `consumer`, `delegate`, `compute` | Asset download, Databank querying |
| **OrgAdmin** | `nithish@sirpi.io` | Organization Admin | Tenant management |

---

## Client-Side Envelope Encryption Workflow

1. Client generates a local 256-bit symmetric AES Data Encryption Key (DEK).
    
2. Client encrypts the file locally with AES-GCM-256.
    
3. Client invokes `GET /v1/encryption/public-key` to fetch the Cloud KMS RSA public key.
    
4. Client wraps (encrypts) the AES DEK using `RSA-OAEP-3072-SHA256`.
    
5. Client uploads the encrypted asset payload along with the wrapped DEK and `kmsKeyVersion`.

request.description:
#### Obtain Access Token (CosAdmin)
Authenticates the CosAdmin persona (`admin.cos.iudx.v2@datakaveri.org`) against Keycloak realm `iudx-v2`.

- **Endpoint**: `POST https://v2.dev.iudx.io/auth/realms/iudx-v2/protocol/openid-connect/token`
- **Content-Type**: `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`
- **Body Parameters**:
  - `grant_type`: `password`
  - `client_id`: `angular-client`
  - `username`: `admin.cos.iudx.v2@datakaveri.org`
  - `password`: `{{cosAdminPassword}}`
- **Post-Request Action**: Automatically saves `access_token` into `accessToken` and `cosAdminAccessToken`.

item.description:
### Authentication & Authorization Module
This folder contains requests to authenticate users against the IUDX Keycloak IAM service and obtain JWT access tokens.

#### Automated Variable Management:
Each request in this folder has a **Tests script** that automatically:
1. Validates that Keycloak returns `200 OK`.
2. Extracts `access_token` and `refresh_token`.
3. Stores the token into both role-specific environment variables (`cosAdminAccessToken`, `providerAccessToken`, `consumerAccessToken`) and the active `accessToken` variable used across all requests in the collection.

item.name: Databanks
1. List Files

request.description: Verifies file listing returns 200 OK when querying a registered databank.
Verifies calling list files without an Authorization header is rejected with 401.
Verifies users without provider access are rejected with 403 Forbidden.

item.description:
### List files in a databank directory
Returns a list of files and directories in the specified databank directory.
- **Endpoint**: `POST /v1/databanks/:databankId/files`
- **Access Control**: `provider`, `consumer`
- **Request Body**: `prefix`, `delimiter`, `maxKeys`, `recursive`

item.name: 2. Download File

request.description: Verifies download endpoint issues presigned URL with 200 OK for valid file.
Verifies requesting a non-existent file returns 404.

item.description:
### Download file from databank
Generates a presigned download URL for a specific file in a databank.
- **Endpoint**: `POST /v1/databanks/:databankId/files/download`
- **Access Control**: `provider`, `consumer`
- **Request Body**: `file` (or `key`), `expiresIn`

item.name: 3. File Metadata

request.description: Verifies public metadata endpoint returns 200 OK with file properties.
Verifies querying metadata for non-existent file returns 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.

item.description:
### Get file metadata
Retrieves S3/storage metadata (content-length, last-modified, etag, content-type) for a file.
- **Endpoint**: `POST /v1/databanks/:databankId/files/metadata`
- **Access Control**: `provider`, `consumer`
- **Request Body**: `file` (or `key`)

item.name: 4. File Preview

Generates an inline preview or thumbnail link for supported file formats.
- **Endpoint**: `POST /v1/databanks/:databankId/files/preview`
- **Access Control**: `provider`, `consumer`
- **Request Body**: `file` (or `key`), `format`, `page`

item.name: 6. Initiate Upload

Verifies invalid upload initiation returns 400 Bad Request.

item.description:
### Initiate multipart upload
Initializes a multipart upload session for large files.
- **Endpoint**: `POST /v1/databanks/:databankId/uploads`
- **Access Control**: `provider`, `cos_admin`
- **Request Body**: `fileName`, `fileSize`, `mimeType`, `parts`

item.name: 7. Complete Upload

request.description: Verifies completing multipart upload returns 200 OK.
Verifies empty parts list is rejected with 400.

item.description:
### Complete multipart upload
Finalizes an active multipart upload session by assembling uploaded parts.
- **Endpoint**: `PUT /v1/databanks/:databankId/uploads/:uploadId`
- **Access Control**: `provider`, `cos_admin`
- **Request Body**: `parts` array with PartNumber and ETag

item.description:
### Create processing job
Dispatches an asynchronous background processing job on databank contents.
- **Endpoint**: `POST /v1/databanks/:databankId/process`
- **Access Control**: `provider`, `cos_admin`
- **Request Body**: `jobType`, `parameters`

Polls current execution status, progress percentage, and outputs for a job.

item.description:

Updates job state (running, completed, failed) and attaches execution logs.
- **Endpoint**: `PUT /v1/databanks/:databankId/process/:jobId/status`
- **Access Control**: `cos_admin`

item.description:
### Cancel multipart upload
Aborts an in-progress multipart upload and purges allocated temporary parts.
- **Endpoint**: `POST /v1/databanks/:databankId/uploads/:uploadId/cancel`
- **Access Control**: `provider`, `cos_admin`
- **Request Body**: `reason`

item.name: 5. Delete File

request.description: Deletes a file from the databank. Requires databank owner (Provider) role.

#### Delete File - 404 Not Found (Specification vs Actual Live Server Behavior)

- **OpenAPI 3.0 Contract Specification**:
  - `POST /v1/databanks/:databankId/files/delete`
  - Defines `404 Not Found` when a file does not exist:
    ```json
    {
      "success": false,
      "error": {
        "code": "RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND",
        "message": "File not found: missing-file-404.csv"
      }
    }
    ```
- **Actual Live Server Behavior**:
  - The live server returns HTTP `200 OK` with `{"success": true, "data": {"message": "File deleted successfully: ..."}}` even when deleting a file key that does not exist.
- **Root Cause (S3 Idempotency Defect DEF-038)**:
  - In AWS S3, `DeleteObject` is an idempotent operation. S3 returns HTTP 204/200 success rather than 404 when deleting an object that does not exist.
  - The API router calls `s3.deleteObject()` directly without checking object existence (`s3.headObject()`) first.
  - The backend interprets the S3 success response as a successful deletion and sends `200 OK: File deleted successfully`.
- **Test Assertion**:
  - Validates that the response conforms to either `404 Not Found` (contract specification) or `200 OK` (live server S3 idempotency defect DEF-038).

item.description:
### Delete file from databank
Deletes a specific file object from the databank directory.
- **Endpoint**: `POST /v1/databanks/:databankId/files/delete`
- **Access Control**: `provider`, `cos_admin`
- **Request Body**: `file` (or `key`)

### Databanks Module
Endpoints for managing files within dataset databanks: listing, downloading, metadata lookup, multipart uploads, processing jobs, and AWS STS temporary credentials.
- **Roles**: `provider`, `consumer` (Metadata is public)
- **Base Route**: `/v1/databanks/{databankId}/...`

item.name: Assets
1. Upload Asset

request.description: Verifies uploading a valid asset file (PNG/JPEG/PDF) returns 201 Created.
Verifies request with missing file returns 400 Bad Request.

item.description:
### Upload an asset (multipart/form-data)
Uploads an asset using multipart/form-data and returns a unique key for future reference. Only PDF and image files are allowed (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, SVG, TIFF, BMP).

- **Endpoint**: `POST /v1/assets`
- **Access Control**: `provider`, `consumer`, `cos_admin`
- **Body**: `multipart/form-data` with form field `file`
- **Max File Size**: 10MB

item.name: 2. Download Asset

request.description: Verifies generating presigned URL for an asset returns 200 OK.
Verifies non-existent asset key returns 404 Not Found.

item.description:
### Get a presigned URL for an asset
Returns a presigned URL for downloading an asset.

- **Endpoint**: `POST /v1/assets/download`
- **Access Control**: `provider`, `cos_admin`
- **Request Body**: `key` (required), `expiresIn` (optional)

### Assets Module
Endpoints for uploading and downloading platform assets (PDF, images: JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, SVG, TIFF, BMP).
- **Allowed Upload Roles**: `provider`, `consumer`, `cos_admin`
- **Allowed Download Roles**: `provider`, `cos_admin`
- **Max File Size**: 10MB
